name: com.javienne.startup-diagnostics
description: Times the cold start of a game, from the start of the process to its first playable screen, and logs it in one line on Android, iOS and in Play Mode.

samples.description: An interactive tutorial in the editor: the startup timeline, a measure on a device, its results, what to shorten and a Profiler capture. Needs the Tutorial Framework (com.unity.learn.iet-framework 5.0 or later), to install first.
